item.text:
Audited all 46 Roman verses against the Urdu opening and 11 stanzas. Corrected house spellings, nasal vowels, izafat, and transcription errors including `Maah-e-Safar`, `Dekh luṅ`, and `qaza`. Updated both vocatives in the Roman title to `Ae`.

The Urdu body was preserved byte for byte. Stanza 9 retains `Dil mein mere hasrat hai mere`, including the repeated `mere` in the source, for human editorial sign-off.
